defaults.source: Distilled from [developer.shopware.com](https://developer.shopware.com) (Storefront guides and reference) plus the Shopware 6.7 Storefront source, retrieved 2026-08-20.

controller.title: Shopware Storefront controllers and pages
controller.description: Shopware Storefront controllers, Pages, Pagelets, PageLoaders, attaching data, AJAX routes. Use when building a Shopware Storefront controller or page.
controller.intro: A Storefront request becomes a Page built by a PageLoader. Extending existing data means decorating a PageLoader, not the controller.

twig.title: Shopware Storefront Twig
twig.description: Shopware Storefront Twig: template inheritance and blocks, Twig extensions, available functions, snippets. Use when overriding a Shopware Storefront template or writing a Twig extension.
twig.intro: Templates are overridden by mirroring the path, never by editing core. Blocks are the extension points.

javascript.title: Shopware Storefront JavaScript
javascript.description: Shopware Storefront JavaScript: writing, overriding and extending plugins, the plugin and event catalogues, TypeScript. Use when the request names a Shopware Storefront JS plugin or its events.
javascript.intro: Storefront JS is a plugin system: register a class against a selector. The catalogues list what already exists before you write a new one.

theme.title: Shopware theme and SCSS
theme.description: Shopware themes: creating a theme, theme.json config, inheritance, multiple themes, compilation, SCSS structure and variables, assets and icons. Use when building or styling a Shopware theme.
theme.intro: A theme is a plugin with a theme.json. Variables and inheritance decide how much you have to override.

features.title: Shopware Storefront features
features.description: Shopware Storefront features: listing filters, custom sorting, SEO URLs, sitemap, cookie consent, captcha, HTTP caching. Use when the request names a Shopware listing filter or SEO URL.
features.intro: Self-contained Storefront features, each with its own extension point.
